subject: MAP: Close playbook and activation cadence for NovaLabs
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <e.torres@novalabs.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: MAP and close cadence — draft & target approvals

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive session yesterday. As discussed, attached is the updated Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MAP_NovaLabs_v2.pdf) with the condensed approval path and a proposed activation cadence. The key asks from our side: legal sign-off on the SOW, a purchase order or signed DocuSign envelope, and a named technical kickoff owner from NovaLabs.

Highlights (please confirm):
- Target internal exec approval deadline: Tue 2026-12-22 17:00 PT
- Procurement release (PO or signed DocuSign): by Thu 2026-12-30
- Planned first-day-of-work / environment handover: Mon 2027-01-03

I've also attached a one-page close checklist we use for Dedicated/private deployments. If those dates or dependencies are tight on your side, let us know — we can compress the window but it will change the resource commitment.

Next steps suggestion:
1) You confirm approver names and whether NovaLabs will sign via DocuSign or provide a PO.
2) Rishi to confirm SOW minor redlines and finalize.
3) Dev to prepare onboarding list for networking/VPC details once PO is received.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_NovaLabs_v2.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0187
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <e.torres@novalabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Li <t.li@novalabs.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP and close cadence — draft & target approvals

Vanessa —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline. Quick clarifying questions from our procurement/ops side:
1) Our legal wants the final SOW with Redwood's standard data handling paragraph included. Is that already baked into SOW_NovaLabs_v3 or is that a separate addendum?
2) Procurement will need a 7–10 business day window to issue a PO; can you accept a PO arrival by 30 Dec? If not, we may need to push the onboarding start back to Jan 10.
3) For DocuSign: do you have a pre-built envelope we can route to our CFO and Head of Security? If so, please send link.

Tom (cc'd) is our Program Lead and will shepherd approvals. We prefer a DocuSign flow if possible — it's quicker than chasing an internal PO in our case.

Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Product Ops, NovaLabs
e.torres@novalabs.com | +1 212-555-4469
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <e.torres@novalabs.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP and close cadence — draft & target approvals

Elena —

Thanks for the questions. Short answers below, plus next actions.

1) SOW: SOW_NovaLabs_v3.docx (attached) includes our standard data handling and privacy clause in section 6. I flagged two minor redlines (billing window and a maximum latency SLA example) — nothing material. Vanessa, please confirm if NovaLabs wants the SLA tightened; that will affect pricing.

2) PO timing: Accepting a PO by 30 Dec is fine. If NovaLabs elects DocuSign instead we can expedite to have the envelope routed by EOD Tue 2026-12-22. Either path meets the planned Jan 3 start as long as we receive signed paperwork + initial onboarding form 72 hours before handover.

3) DocuSign: I'll generate a pre-populated envelope with the SOW and the MSA summary. Expect a link from DocuSign (I will cc Vanessa).

Procurement checklist attached: procurement_checklist.xlsx — this maps the internal items we need from NovaLabs (network CIDRs, firewall whitelist, billing contact, PO/Signer info).

Go/no-go rule set (for our mutual clarity):
- Go: signed DocuSign or PO received + legal sign-off on the SOW by 30 Dec -> kickoff 2027-01-03
- Hold: PO pending or legal outstanding past 30 Dec -> push kickoff to next available window (earliest 2027-01-10)
- Cancel: material contract changes requested after legal sign-off that require new pricing review -> re-evaluate MAP

I'll create DocuSign envelope and reply with the link by EOD.

Attachments: SOW_NovaLabs_v3.docx, procurement_checklist.xlsx

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Platform Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
From: Elena Torres <e.torres@novalabs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Li <t.li@novalabs.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP and close cadence — draft & target approvals

Rishi / Vanessa —

Good news: our Executive committee reviewed this morning and we're cleared to proceed pending signature. Tom has routed the DocuSign to our CFO and Head of Security — you'll get the signed envelope back to the contact you send it to.

We're attaching our signed PO here for your records (po_novalabs_2026_signed.pdf). We can accept the Jan 3 start date — Tom will be the named technical lead for the kickoff.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll upload the signed DocuSign/PO to our procurement portal by EOD Tue 2026-12-22.
- Tom will complete the procurement_checklist fields and send network contact details by 2026-12-27.

Thanks — happy to be moving this to execution.

Elena

Attachment: po_novalabs_2026_signed.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <e.torres@novalabs.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP and close cadence — draft & target approvals

Elena / Tom / Rishi —

Fantastic — thank you and congrats to the team. Confirming Redwood received the signed PO and that the DocuSign envelope will follow. Per our MAP:

- We treat this thread as the single source of truth for the GO/NO-GO. With the PO in place and no outstanding legal changes, we are green for the Jan 3 handover.
- Dev: please schedule the onboarding call for 2026-12-29 to review network/VPC checklist and deliver the onboarding form (72 hours before handover).
- Marissa: I'll loop you for account enablement and billing setup once the signed DocuSign is in.

Tentative kickoff calendar invite: https://calendar.redwoodinference.com/event/novalabs-kickoff-20270103

If anything changes on your end, please reply-all immediately. Otherwise, we'll treat this as final GO and proceed with setup. Looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
